tagline: Gold & Diamond Jewellery, Crafted with Trust
address: Shop 12, Gold Souk Area, Deira, Dubai, UAE
hero_subheading: Discover fine gold and diamond jewellery for every occasion — crafted with purity, backed by trust, in the heart of Dubai.
about_paragraph_1: Shagun Jewellery Trading LLC has been serving Dubai's community with certified, hallmarked gold and diamond jewellery, combining traditional craftsmanship with modern design.
about_paragraph_2: Every piece that leaves our showroom is checked for purity and quality — because trust is the real ornament we offer our customers.
custom_design_text: Share a photo or sketch of the design you're dreaming of, along with your requirements — metal type, weight, budget, or occasion. Our team will get back to you with a quote and timeline.
footer_note: All jewellery is hallmarked and certified. Prices vary with daily gold rates.
